title: Clockwork Puppet Theater
description: Kira stands on a mechanical stage powered by an interlocking gear system. The user controls the gear rotation speed and direction to drive Kira through a sequence of choreographed animation poses, adjusting timing parameters to synchronize the puppet's movements with the mechanical rhythm of the gears beneath her.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements a Clockwork Puppet Theater scene. Load both shared_assets/gears.glb and shared_assets/kira.glb using GLTFLoader from a CDN. Place the gears model centered at y=0 as a mechanical stage platform. Position Kira standing on top of the gears at approximately y equal to the top of the gear assembly. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 6) looking at the center. Add an AmbientLight intensity 0.4, a DirectionalLight from (5, 8, 5) intensity 1.0 with warm color, and a SpotLight from above with a slight blue tint for theatrical effect. Create an HTML control panel overlay with these interactions: (1) A speed slider from 0.1 to 3.0 controlling gear rotation speed with a numeric display showing current RPM value. (2) A direction toggle button switching gear rotation between clockwise and counter-clockwise. (3) A dropdown to select one of four animation phases: Idle, Wave, Dance, Bow. Each phase should apply a different procedural animation to Kira using sinusoidal transforms on her skeleton bones or root transform if no skeleton: Idle is subtle breathing sway, Wave raises and oscillates one arm group, Dance applies rhythmic vertical bounce and rotation, Bow tilts the upper body forward. (4) A transition duration input field accepting values between 0.2 and 2.0 seconds, validated on change with clamping and a red border flash for out-of-range values. (5) A beat sync checkbox that when enabled locks Kira's animation phase transitions to trigger only on full gear rotations. (6) A camera orbit toggle that enables slow automatic camera orbiting around the scene. The gears should rotate continuously based on the speed and direction parameters. Kira's procedural animations should blend smoothly using the configured transition duration. Display a small status bar showing current gear angle in degrees, active animation phase, and whether beat sync is engaged. Use OrbitControls for manual camera interaction when auto-orbit is disabled. Render with antialiasing enabled and a dark gradient background suggesting a theater stage.
